transferable_decisions: Keep flanking anchor context outside midpoint display window.
Use explicit assembly/genomic interval/bin edges across contact, signal, arcs and genes.
Keep source-specific colour limits distinct from a new cross-condition shared-scale design.
Compute500bp binary Jaccard before20x20 block averaging; do not reverse those operations.
Never reinterpret top10percent Zscore labels as qvalue significance.
Fresh CP2 and actual final source comparison remain mandatory before new plotting approval.
